brief:
Gaza's armed groups commemorated the October 7 operation, which they characterize as a transformative confrontation that altered the course of history and inscribed new chapters of honor, according to Shehab Wire. The account describes the operation as having inflicted defeat and humiliation on the Israeli military, characterizing its forces as cowardly.

The anniversary observances reflect how Palestinian factions frame the October 7 attack and the war that followed, positioning the operation as a defining moment in Palestinian resistance history.

title: Palestinians mark October 7 anniversary of Al-Aqsa Flood operation
